description_en: Retrieves pricing mapping catalogs in batches by Terraform resource type for cost estimation during the RunIaC plan phase
description_zh: 按 Terraform 资源类型批量获取询价 mapping 目录（供 RunIaC plan 阶段成本预估）
name: GetTerraformPricingMappings

parameters.help_en: The request body. The resourceTypes field specifies a list of Terraform resource types, such as alicloud_instance. You can specify a maximum of 200 resource types in a single request
parameters.help_zh: 请求体：resourceTypes（Terraform 资源类型列表，如 alicloud_instance），单次最多 200 个
parameters.name: body

mappingVersion.description_en: The mapping content version, which is the timestamp of the most recent data change. Consumers can use this value for caching and auditing
mappingVersion.description_zh: mapping 内容版本（数据最近变更时间戳），用于消费方缓存与审计
mappingVersion.title_zh: mapping 内容版本（数据最近变更时间戳），用于消费方缓存与审计

mappings.description_en: The list of matched mappings. Each item contains a resourceType and pricingTargets, which include pricing targets and parameter extraction rules. The rules reference Terraform plan resource properties by using $after/$before
mappings.description_zh: 命中的 mapping 列表：每项含 resourceType 与 pricingTargets（询价目标与参数抽取规则，规则内 $after/$before 引用 Terraform plan 的资源属性）

items.description_en: The pricing mapping for a single resource type
items.description_zh: 单个资源类型的询价 mapping

pricingTargets.description_en: The list of pricing targets. Each item contains actions (create/update), popCode/popVersion/apiName, pricingUnit, params (parameter extraction rules: from=$after.xxx / const / default / expand), and when/whenChanged conditions
pricingTargets.description_zh: 询价目标列表：每项含 actions（create/update）、popCode/popVersion/apiName、pricingUnit、params（参数抽取规则：from=$after.xxx / const / default / expand）、when/whenChanged 条件

items.description_en: A single pricing target, which contains the API triplet (popCode, popVersion, and apiName) and parameter extraction rules required for a pricing call
items.description_zh: 单个询价目标：一次询价调用所需的 API 三元组与参数抽取规则
items.title_zh: 单个询价目标：一次询价调用所需的 API 三元组与参数抽取规则

pricingTargets.title_zh: 询价目标列表：每项含 actions（create/update）、popCode/popVersion/apiName、pricingUnit、params（参数抽取规则：from=$after.xxx / const / default / expand）、when/whenChanged 条件

resourceType.description_en: The Terraform resource type, such as alicloud_instance

items.title_zh: 单个资源类型的询价 mapping

mappings.title_zh: 命中的 mapping 列表：每项含 resourceType 与 pricingTargets（询价目标与参数抽取规则，规则内 $after/$before 引用 Terraform plan 的资源属性）

missingResourceTypes.description_en: The resource types in the request that do not have registered mappings. Consumers must treat these as unknown cost. Do not assume they are free
missingResourceTypes.description_zh: 请求中未注册 mapping 的资源类型；消费方必须按费用未知处理，不得当作免费

items.description_en: A Terraform resource type without a registered mapping. The cost is unknown, which does not mean the resource is free
items.description_zh: 未注册 mapping 的 Terraform 资源类型，费用未知（不等于免费）
items.title_zh: 未注册 mapping 的 Terraform 资源类型，费用未知（不等于免费）

missingResourceTypes.title_zh: 请求中未注册 mapping 的资源类型；消费方必须按费用未知处理，不得当作免费

schemaVersion.description_en: The schema version of the mapping catalog. The current version is 1.0. Consumers use this value to determine compatibility
schemaVersion.description_zh: mapping 目录 schema 版本，当前为 1.0；消费方按此判断兼容性
schemaVersion.title_zh: mapping 目录 schema 版本，当前为 1.0；消费方按此判断兼容性

unsupportedResourceTypes.description_en: The resource types that are confirmed to not support pricing, such as free resources or resources without a pricing interface. These are different from missing resource types
unsupportedResourceTypes.description_zh: 已确认不支持询价的资源类型（如纯免费或无询价面），与 missing 区分

items.description_en: A Terraform resource type that is confirmed to have no pricing interface, such as a free resource
items.description_zh: 已确认无询价面的 Terraform 资源类型，如纯免费资源
items.title_zh: 已确认无询价面的 Terraform 资源类型，如纯免费资源

unsupportedResourceTypes.title_zh: 已确认不支持询价的资源类型（如纯免费或无询价面），与 missing 区分
